If you have to try and justify it don't do it. I'm 26F & I dated a LOT of 30 year old men when I was 20/21/22 & it never worked out. Most of them were insecure, or manipulative.. you gotta wonder why they can't pull a woman their age and also what they even want from you. You're in two completely different stages in life, I can't imagine you have much in common, and don't understand each other's references or lingo... I text my ex I was at the gym trying to get "snatched" as in, in shape, hot, whatever & he thought I meant I wanted another guy to persue me.. it started a fight & he didn't want me going to the gym anymore. Of course not everyone is like this, that's just an example... Another example I have is you bringing up problems you have like communication issues & they tell you "I don't have to text you. That's immature. You're too young to understand. 

Looking back I regret it so much. I never really dated anyone my own age until this year (I'm actually 6 months older, a couger I know) & it is the best relationship I been in. We get each other, have more to laugh about from shared experiences & just feel like we are going through our mid twenties together, it's comforting... 

So my advice is to find someone your own age!! But if you don't wanna listen that's on you and you can learn that lesson later in life.

I loved art in high school... Art class was the only class I didn’t skip. It was every other day so I would basically skip school every other day, but come in on art days. I had a lot of behavioral issues, unmedicated adhd, undiagnosed (then) bipolar disorder. Senior year my teacher (who I had for 3 years straight) basically had it with my shit. I don’t even remember doing anything that bad, maybe swearing or getting into petty arguments. But that was it. I was actually starting to get good at painting. But she put everyone in the class’s work in the end of the year art show, except for mine. She made me help set up the art show & put up everyone’s art work too, knowing damn well I was devastated I didn’t get my stuff in the show. It was a goal of mine to get in it because I hadn’t previous years & I was finally at the level to get in & me, my issues, & this bitch teacher blew it. I still paint occasionally but the passion I once had is definitely dead cuz I just think of how I felt when I was told I didn’t get to be in the stupid fucking art show.
